rehearsal.ranFrom: a clean checkout of the release commit, with --ci-run naming the producer CI run

inspection.againstPrevious: Against the published 5.15.0: the same 86 files by count. dist/index.js, its map, dist/drawings.js and dist/index.d.ts change for the four chosen roles (control.chosen, control.chosenHover, control.chosenPressed, control.chosenInk) and a role following another; dist/quickcharts.css paints chosen rows, tiles and held toggles from the chosen roles; the theme manifest adds the four roles; package.json and the feature manifest change the version; README.md and CHANGELOG.md document the change; the one shared chunk takes a new name with its map. The export map, LICENSE, NOTICE, THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and the REST description are unchanged.

ownerWaiver.statement: Remember, you could run the quick charts releases. Like, nothing should be left open if you have enough to work on the things.
ownerWaiver.question: Releasing Quick Charts 5.16.0 end to end (acceptance record, tag, release.yml, npm-publish).
ownerWaiver.answerDetail: Said by the owner in the trdrs-app main session, which runs this release. Manual accessibility and advertised browser and device acceptance were not performed; the browser suites passed in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
